definitions: To view something with skepticism or to not completely believe it.
To accept something as true only with reservations or caution.
examples: You should take his advice with a grain of salt; he's often wrong.
I take everything she says with a grain of salt.
Take that rumor with a grain of salt.
lemma: to take something with a grain of salt
synonyms: to take something with a pinch of salt
source: to take something with a grain of salt
